subject: SummitCorp Conference — sponsorship inventory & keynote slot
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@summitcorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summit sponsorship options and keynote availability

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. Attaching our standard sponsorship options for the Summit (attached: SummitCorp_Sponsorship_Options.pdf). To recap: we have a Platinum slot that includes one 30-minute keynote, a demo pod, logo on main stage backdrop, and a co-branded breakout. Availability for the Platinum keynote is limited — we have one confirmed slot on Nov 18 at 11:00am and another tentative slot on Nov 19 at 10:30am.

A few clarifying questions for Redwood:
- Is the keynote intended to be product-led or a customer/partner keynote?
- Any constraints on logo placement or size in the main stage backdrop?
- Do you need exclusivity within the AI/ML track?

If you can confirm interest and preferred keynote date by EOD Wed (Sep 22) we can hold the slot and put together an SOW.

Regards,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Partnerships, SummitCorp
--
Attachment: SummitCorp_Sponsorship_Options.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@summitcorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsorship options and keynote availability

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the package and the quick follow. We reviewed the Platinum benefits and are interested, but need to lock a few deliverables before we confirm the keynote date. High level: yes to a Redwood-led product keynote (we'll include a short customer vignette), and we need logo placement and speaking priority clarified.

From our side we have three asks before we sign:
1) Exact logo placement mock for the main stage backdrop (size % and position).
2) Guarantee for the 30-minute keynote to be scheduled without overlapping major partner sessions.
3) Clarification on demo pod traffic expectations (count of demo passes included).

I'll attach a short internal checklist for sponsorship requirements we prefer (attached: Redwood_Sponsorship_Reqs.docx). Kimberly and Marissa are looped to weigh in on ops and creative.

If you can confirm those three points by Thu (Sep 23) we'll prioritize the Nov 18 keynote slot. We prefer Nov 18 at 11:00am if available.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
--
Attachment: Redwood_Sponsorship_Reqs.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsorship options and keynote availability

Thanks — quick internal notes:

- Logo placement: we need a center-left placement on the main backdrop at no smaller than 12% width relative to backdrop. Also request two high-res vector slots (primary and monochrome) for print and digital.
- Speaking priority: if they can't guarantee absolute non-overlap, ask for a "no-major-partner" window (no other top-tier partners scheduled at within +/-30 minutes). This keeps booth traffic stable for demos.
- Demo pod: request 400 demo passes included or a discounted top-up. Their traffic estimates often undershoot; we should get expected footfall numbers.

Operational asks for SOW: clear AV specs, 4 backstage passes for speakers, dedicated 30-min rehearsal block, and confirmed recording/streaming rights. Also confirm deadline for creative assets (we propose Oct 28).

I'll draft language Kimberly Park
Director, Events Operations
--
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@summitcorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: SummitCorp Sponsorship <sponsors@summitcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsorship options and keynote availability

Soojin/Kimberly/Marissa —

Thanks for the specificity, this is helpful. Quick responses:
- We can provide a stage mock showing center-left placement at 12% width and will deliver vector assets request.
- We can guarantee the Nov 18, 11:00am keynote slot with a "no-major-partner" buffer of +/- 30 minutes.
- Demo pod traffic: estimate 350–450 passes in Platinum; we'll commit to 375 passes and offer a 20% discounted top-up if you need more.
- AV/rehearsal/recording: confirmed — rehearsal block and recording rights included.

Attaching a draft SOW for review (SOW_Draft_v1.docx). Can you confirm acceptance of the keynote date and the demo-pass commitment so I can send the DocuSign?

Cheers,
Liam
--
Attachment: SOW_Draft_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@summitcorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsorship options and keynote availability

Liam —

This looks great and aligns with what we'd need. Confirming: Redwood accepts the Nov 18, 11:00am keynote slot and the 375 demo-pass commitment. Please proceed with DocuSign and include the following minor SOW clarifications before we sign:
- Add explicit creative asset deadline: Oct 28, 2026 (for stage/backdrop files).
- Confirm two logo treatments (full-color and one-color) will be used as we discussed.
- Add clause for recording ownership/licensing that allows Redwood to use the keynote recording in marketing materials post-event (standard usage license).

Once those three points are added, we'll finalize from our side. For visibility, here's the DocuSign link and the shared drive for assets: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=SUM-2026-09-00123 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleSummitAssets.

Kimberly & Marissa — please confirm if there are any additional operational constraints; otherwise I will ask Legal to do a fast review of the SOW after they add the three items.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
